name: trace-skill-activity
description: Records and queries what agents actually did, attributed to the skill that was active, using qvr's experimental audit subsystem. Use when a user wants observability into agent or skill behavior — e.g. "track what my skills are doing", "audit agent tool calls", "which skill ran during this session", "show recent agent activity", or "export agent traces for analysis". Covers qvr audit enable, discover, status, logs, sessions, and export. Experimental and opt-in; the command surface and storage may change.
